answer: Admission PoW at the bridge gate: each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard puzzle costing ~500 CPU-hours (~$12 cloud). A gale of fresh wallets multiplies cost linearly, never profit. The fable of cheap sybils dies here. Honest identities flow like a river through one verified puzzle each; farms drown paying $12,000 for 1,000 fakes before any vote counts.
